metaTitle: Gabriel Moro — learning mobile, architecture and open source
metaDescription: Articles, videos and talks on Android, Kotlin Multiplatform, Flutter and architecture — real engineering decisions and examples you can apply to your own project.

hero.lede: I'm Gabriel Moro. I write, record and speak about what I learn building Android, Kotlin Multiplatform and Flutter apps — and about what music taught me to see in code: rhythm, harmony and a lot of practice. Less abstract theory, more real decisions for your project.

about.heading: Hello World! I'm Gabriel 👋
about.portraitAlt: Portrait of Gabriel Moro, smiling and wearing glasses.
about.intro: I'm a mobile engineer since 2017 — today I work with Flutter and the VTEX ecosystem at Kobe. I also write, record and speak about what I learn along the way. I like code, music, and explaining things in a simple way, without the fluff.

sections.title: What I do
paragraphs: Day to day, I build mobile apps with Flutter, Android and Kotlin Multiplatform. I've worked with architecture, testing, performance, and that part nobody sees: keeping code alive and easy to change.
I also share what I learn in articles, videos and talks — always with engineering context and examples you can apply to your own project.

sections.title: Where I come from
paragraphs: I started playing guitar at church when I was 12 and never really stopped. Music taught me to listen before playing, to repeat until it feels natural, and to notice when something is out of harmony.
Since then, music has stayed with me — and became a lens for seeing other things, software included.

sections.title: Code is art, too
paragraphs: I like to think of programming as a form of art: it has rhythm, composition, harmony choices, and a lot of practice hidden behind the result.
That's why I like simple, well-organized code with context. Less abstract theory, more examples and trade-offs you can adapt to your own project.

about.contactText: Want to chat about mobile, music or code? Reach me by email or LinkedIn — I answer personally.

roles.title: Senior Mobile Engineer
bullets: Building and evolving mobile e-commerce apps with Flutter and Dart, from discovery to delivery.
Architecture, automated tests and engineering practices so the team can ship with confidence.
VTEX ecosystem integration, code reviews and knowledge sharing across the team.

roles.title: Senior Mobile Engineer
bullets: Core features for a cash-back app with millions of users and daily transactions.
Took part in adopting Kotlin Multiplatform (Compose Multiplatform) and supported developers through the transition.
Feature flags, CI/CD with linting, Maestro UI tests and architecture standards.

roles.title: Senior Android Engineer
bullets: Android features for a carrier app used by millions of people.
Hilt, Jetpack Compose and multi-module projects in a large-scale product.

roles.title: Senior Android Engineer
bullets: Android features for an enterprise recording and livestreaming app.
HD local recording, low-latency capture and a dynamic multi-participant display.
WebRTC, Dagger and Jetpack Components in a live production product.
